name: Модерація

units.scope: 834 unit cases plus deleted-material UI; opt-in external/emulator cases intentionally excluded and accounted separately

server.scope: Actual handlers, Firestore/Auth emulators, all role variants, CAS, legacy compatibility, receipt/replay/history, recipient isolation and revoked reviewer

states.scope: 7 role variants; initial/read errors and retry, true empty, two pages/search/return, slow type switch

large.scope: German dark Accessibility XXXL; complete event fields, image retry, required reason, cancel/retain draft, scrollable confirmation, history and current material

news.scope: Actual SDK, Rules and callable HTTP in fixed demo; return -> exact author inbox -> editor -> save/readback -> resubmit -> approve -> fresh home feed; new-notice creation time is strictly after this run began

event.scope: Actual SDK, Rules and callable HTTP in fixed demo; return -> author inbox -> event editor -> save/readback -> resubmit -> reject -> recipient notice; requires the exact notice to have been created after this test started

fresh.scope: Independent readback after the exact accepted test start time; one outcome notice per contributor, staff-only own resubmission, no reviewer/outsider delivery

device.scope: Final signed Release from product source 4f00a4df explicitly installed. Current Serlest production session, confirmed server counts and loaded news/event queues plus history; no content decisions or writes.

deployment.scope: ACTIVE, exact TS/compiled JS archive match, onDeploy runtime policy, Cloud Run Ready with 100 percent traffic; anonymous JSON401 only proves startup, device case proves authorized read

keyboard.scope: Unmodified AppSearchField/keyboard dismissal implementation; baseline reproduced keyboard loss, fixed tests retain focus across clear, same control used here

bilingual.scope: uk light normal and de dark Accessibility M, translated news preview, background/return, reason, native/accessibility confirmation and decision history

frames.scope: Representative 4fps extraction: unknown counts/loading -> confirmed news -> event loading with no old rows -> confirmed empty. Not a claim of inspecting every video frame.

findings.problem: Refresh failure erased confirmed queue; duplicate and late reads could replace current state.
findings.fix: Scope/generation fence, retained confirmed data, coalesced first pages, exact retry cursor, deduplication.

findings.problem: Unknown counts could look like zero; initial failure and empty data were not clearly separated.
findings.fix: Unknown counts shown as dash; explicit loaded/error/loading/empty states and semantic read error copy.

findings.problem: Read-only preview close reset loaded pages.
findings.fix: Refresh only after actual material changes, decision or observed revision change.

findings.problem: Moderation preview omitted material terms needed for an informed event decision.
findings.fix: Add compatible optional full publication DTO and localized conditions, dates, contacts and image metadata; preserve lightweight list projection.

findings.problem: A confirmation could follow changed UI context and maximum-size native alerts were cramped.
findings.fix: Freeze principal/target/revision/outcome/reason; use scrollable confirmation and inline action at accessibility sizes.

findings.problem: History did not open the reviewed material.
findings.fix: Typed history link opens current read-only material; deleted material gives a precise explanation and no misleading retry.

findings.problem: Notification navigation instantiated an inner NavigationStack in a pushed destination and returned to the profile root.
findings.fix: Use one stack for pushed material, retain standalone stack for modal queue preview, key both by material identity.

findings.problem: The author could see the same moderation reason twice in notification details.
findings.fix: Keep metadata-only reasons but omit a second copy already present in the localized message.

findings.problem: Newly approved news retained its old publication timestamp.
findings.fix: Approval stamps publishedAt and moderatedAt together; event documents do not receive a news-only field.

findings.problem: The independent home browse cache could miss an approved item while another tab was active.
findings.fix: Invalidate its query on news/moderation changes even while inactive; fetch only on return to the active tab.
proof: ModerationConnectedNewsAccepted.xcresult: baseline failed final feed assertion

testEnvironment.reviewerAuthentication: Fixed emulator-only custom-token assertion because Auth Emulator lacks TOTP; compile-time excluded from Release/device. This is not proof of a real passkey/MFA provider. Production MFA policy was not weakened.
testEnvironment.productionDevice: iPhone 16 Pro Max, iOS 27.0.1, signed Release and current Serlest session
fixtureCorrections: Keep news summary/subtitle and uk localization consistent.
National news has no federal-state restriction; an event still retains the actual venue federal state.
Do not treat a repeated emulator namespace/duplicate auth UID as an application failure.
Native alert action buttons belong to the alert viewport, not its message ScrollView.
Dismiss the keyboard before scrolling to an inline action; an automation gesture starting over the keyboard does not scroll the content.

existingWarnings.warning: Captured self concurrency warning in unchanged source; present in first and final Release build.
Generic Decodable isolation warning in unchanged source; present in first and final Release build.

limits: No new production content approval/rejection was performed.
APNs sender unchanged; new moderation APNs delivery is not claimed.
Search is intentionally described as covering loaded queue pages.
Physical owner read, isolated mutations, source commits, hosted CI, manual acceptance and TestFlight delivery are tracked separately.
